{{Quote|Servant Two has been exposed to the Emperor. He now sees the galaxy differently than most.|Servant One|<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />}}
'''Servant Two''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was an [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]], the most trusted servants of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], alongside one of his colleagues, [[Servant One]].

==Biography==
Servant Two worked in concert with [[Servant One]] and [[Empire's Wrath|the new Emperor's Wrath]] to [[Darth Baras's coup|defeat]] [[Darth Baras]] and was distinguished by Servant One only by always having his head covered in his cloak's hood. Servant Two was exposed to the Emperor, causing him to see the galaxy differently than most, as well as speak in riddles.

In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date2">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> during a discussion the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], the latter claimed both Servant Two and Servant One were long dead.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion">{{TORcite|type=general|Echoes of Oblivion|Odessen}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|When Servant Two whispers, all agents of the Hand hear him.|[[Servant Eleven]]|<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />}}
Servant Two possessed [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]] with a range unhampered by distance; when he whispered, all agents of the Hand could hear him.<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />
